native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Mimikatz Credential Stealer
native_rule.s1ql:
"(
  (
    tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '\mimikatz.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '\mimikat.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '\mimi.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '\mimilove.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'mkatz.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'sekurlsa::logonPasswords'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'lsadump::sam'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'lsadump::secrets'
  )
  AND process.commandLine Does Not ContainCIS 'Log'
)
OR
(
  tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\mimikatz.exe'
  OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\mimikat.exe'
  OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\mimi.exe'
  OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\mimilove.exe'
  OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\mimilib.dll'
  OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\mimidrv.sys'
)"
